environment.note: STREAM_PIPELINE_TIMEOUT_MS was raised to 60s for verification. Playback that succeeds under 60s but fails under 15s indicates timeout sensitivity.

rootCauses: Most failures occur at the "API resolve" stage (24 episodes).
No streams resolved at all — the provider pipeline (search/details/gate) or the 15s pipeline deadline is failing.
recommendations: Investigate the "API resolve" stage — inspect the structured JSON for per-episode failures and the diagnostics/ evidence.

The default 15s STREAM_PIPELINE_TIMEOUT_MS is likely too tight for AnimeHeaven. Confirm whether playback succeeds under a larger deadline (this test used 60s) and raise the production pipeline timeout if so.
Ensure every AnimeHeaven source is rewritten to a same-origin proxy URL before it reaches the client.
Re-run this tool periodically to catch playback regressions, and compare the generated report against the previous run.
